1.def: Present Perfect Continuous — o'tgan zamonda boshlangan va hozirgacha davom etayotgan (yoki hozirgina tugagan, izi ko'rinib turgan) ish. Jarayon va davomiylik muhim.
forms: I have been working here since 2019.
How long have you been waiting?
rules: Belgi: for, since, all day, recently, lately, How long ...?
Jarayon (Continuous) yoki natija (Perfect Simple): I've been painting (jarayon) / I've painted the room (natija).
Holat fe'llari (know, like) Continuous'da ishlatilmaydi.
ex: I've been studying English for three years.
Uch yildan beri ingliz tilini o'rganyapman.
Your eyes are red. Have you been crying?
Ko'zlaring qizarib ketibdi. Yig'laganmiding?
It has been raining all morning.
Ertalabdan beri yomg'ir yog'yapti.
err: I am waiting for two hours.
I have been waiting for two hours.
She has been knowing him for years.
She has known him for years.

2.def: Present Perfect — hozirga aloqasi bor ish yoki tajriba (vaqt aniq emas); Past Simple — tugagan, aniq o'tgan vaqtdagi ish. Aniq vaqt bor-yo'qligi tanlovni belgilaydi.
forms: I have lost my keys. (hozir ham yo'q)
rules: Past Simple: yesterday, last week, in 2020, ago, When ...?
Present Perfect: ever, never, already, yet, just, so far, today / this week (davr tugamagan).
Yangilikni Perfect bilan aytib, tafsilotni Simple bilan davom ettiramiz: I've lost my phone. I left it on the bus.
ex: Have you seen this film? — Yes, I saw it last week.
Bu filmni ko'rganmisan? — Ha, o'tgan hafta ko'rdim.
She has already finished her homework.
U uy vazifasini allaqachon tugatgan.
I didn't see him yesterday.
Kecha uni ko'rmadim.
err: I have seen him last night.

3.def: Present Perfect bilan ishlatiladigan vaqt so'zlari: for (muddat), since (boshlanish nuqtasi), already (allaqachon), yet (hali — savol / inkorda), just (hozirgina), ever (hech), never (hech qachon).
forms: have + V3 + for + muddat / since + nuqta
I've lived here for 5 years / since 2020.
She has already left. I've just arrived.
yet — oxirida; ever — savolda; never — darak gapda
Have you finished yet? I've never been there.
rules: already — darak va ba'zan hayrat bilan savolda; yet — savol va inkorda.
so far = hozirgacha.
gone / been: She has gone to Paris (hali u yerda); She has been to Paris (borib qaytgan).
ex: We haven't decided yet.
Biz hali qaror qilmadik.
Have you ever been abroad?
Hech xorijda bo'lganmisiz?
He has worked here since March.
U martdan beri shu yerda ishlaydi.

4.def: Past Perfect — o'tgan zamondagi ikkita voqeadan OLDIN sodir bo'lganini bildiradi: «... qilgan edi». Qaysi biri birinchi bo'lganini aniq ko'rsatadi.
forms: When I arrived, the film had started.
She hadn't eaten before the exam.
rules: Ikki voqea: oldingisi — Past Perfect, keyingisi — Past Simple.
Belgi: before, after, by the time, already, when, until, as soon as.
Barcha shaxslar uchun had.
ex: I couldn't enter because I had forgotten my key.
Kalitni unutganim uchun kira olmadim.
By the time we got there, the shop had closed.
Biz yetib borgunimizcha do'kon yopilgan edi.
She said she had never seen the sea.
U hech qachon dengizni ko'rmaganini aytdi.
err: When I came, he already left.
When I came, he had already left.

5.def: Kelasi zamon shakllari: will — qaror, va'da, bashorat; going to — reja va belgiga asoslangan bashorat; Present Continuous — aniq kelishilgan reja.
forms: am / is / are + going to + fe'l
rules: Reja bo'lsa — going to; o'sha zahoti qaror — will; vaqti va joyi kelishilgan — Continuous.
Belgi ko'rinsa (Look at the sky) — going to.
will: I think, probably, I'm sure, perhaps.
ex: I'll help you with your bags.
Sumkalaringizga yordam beraman.
We're going to move to a new flat.
Biz yangi kvartiraga ko'chmoqchimiz.
I'm meeting Sara at 6 tomorrow.
Ertaga soat 6 da Sara bilan uchrashaman.
err: I'm going to help you (o'sha zahoti taklif)

6.def: Kelasi zamon vaqt gaplari: when, if, as soon as, before, after, until dan keyin kelasi zamon ma'nosida ham Present Simple ishlatiladi (will emas).
forms: main clause: will + fe'l; time clause: Present Simple
I'll call you when I arrive.
as soon as, before, after, until, by the time
Wait here until I come back.
I'll go out after I have finished.
rules: when / if / as soon as / before / after / until dan keyin will ISHLATILMAYDI.
Gap boshida bo'lsa, vergul qo'yiladi: When I arrive, I'll call you.
If-gapida ham xuddi shunday.
ex: As soon as he comes, we'll start.
U kelishi bilanoq boshlaymiz.
I'll wait until you finish.
Sen tugatguningcha kutaman.
Before you leave, close the window.
Ketishdan oldin derazani yoping.
err: When I will arrive, I'll call you.
When I arrive, I'll call you.
I'll tell him after he will come.
I'll tell him after he comes.

7.def: Zero conditional — doimiy haqiqat va qonuniyat (har doim shunday). First conditional — kelajakda amalga oshishi mumkin bo'lgan shart va uning natijasi.
forms: If you heat ice, it melts.
If it rains, we will stay at home.
unless = if ... not; imperative / can / may natijada
Unless you hurry, you'll be late.
rules: If-qismida will ISHLATILMAYDI.
Zero: «agar ... bo'lsa, doim ...» (ilmiy fakt, odat).
First: real kelajak, ehtimol katta.
ex: If you mix red and blue, you get purple.
Qizil va ko'kni aralashtirsangiz, binafsha rang chiqadi.
If I pass the exam, I'll celebrate.
Imtihondan o'tsam, nishonlayman.
Unless you study, you won't pass.
O'qimasangiz, o'ta olmaysiz.
err: If it will rain, I'll stay home.
If it rains, I'll stay home.
If you will help me, I'll thank you.
If you help me, I'll thank you.

8.def: Second conditional — hozirgi yoki kelajakdagi tasavvur qilinadigan, real bo'lmagan yoki ehtimoli kam holat: «agar ... bo'lsa edi, ... bo'lardi». Orzular va maslahatlar uchun.
forms: If I had a car, I would drive to work.
If I were you, I wouldn't do it.
What would you do if + Past Simple?
What would you do if you won the lottery?
rules: If-qismida Past Simple, lekin ma'no hozirgi / kelajak.
to be: If I were / he were (formal, ko'proq were).
If I were you, I would ... — maslahat berishning eng mashhur usuli.
ex: If I were rich, I would travel the world.
Boy bo'lsam, dunyoni kezardim.
If she knew the answer, she would tell us.
U javobni bilsa edi, bizga aytardi.
I'd buy a house if I had enough money.
Pulim yetarli bo'lsa, uy sotib olardim.
err: If I would have time, I would come.
If I had time, I would come.
If I am you, I would stay.
If I were you, I would stay.

9.def: Third conditional — o'tmishdagi real bo'lmagan holat va uning tasavvuriy natijasi: «agar ... bo'lgan bo'lsa edi, ... bo'lardi». Afsuslanish va tanqid uchun.
forms: If + Past Perfect, would have + V3
If I had known, I would have helped.
If + hadn't + V3, wouldn't have + V3
If we hadn't left late, we wouldn't have missed the train.
What would you have done if ...?
What would you have done if you had lost it?
rules: If-qismida had + V3, natija qismida would have + V3.
Real o'tmishga qarama-qarshi: Men bilmadim → yordam bermadim.
could have / might have ham mumkin: If I had studied, I could have passed.
ex: If I had studied harder, I would have passed.
Qattiqroq o'qiganimda o'tgan bo'lardim.
She would have come if you had invited her.
Siz taklif qilganingizda u kelgan bo'lardi.
If it hadn't rained, we would have gone out.
Yomg'ir yog'masa edi, chiqqan bo'lardik.
err: If I would have known, I would have come.
If I had known, I would have come.
If I had known, I would come.

10.def: Deduction modallari — mavjud dalillarga qarab taxmin qilish: must (juda ishonchli — albatta), might / may / could (ehtimol), can't (aslo bo'lishi mumkin emas).
forms: must / might / could / can't + be / fe'l
He must be tired. She can't be at home.
They must be waiting for us.
He must have forgotten. She can't have left.
rules: must = ~90–95% ishonch; might / could / may = ~50%; can't = ~95% emas.
must inkori mustn't emas, can't.
Taxmin — savol uchun can ishlatiladi: Who can it be?
ex: The lights are on. They must be at home.
Chiroqlar yoniq. Ular uyda bo'lsa kerak.
He might be late; the roads are busy.
U kechikishi mumkin; yo'llar band.
She can't be 30! She looks so young.
U 30 yoshda bo'lishi mumkin emas! Juda yosh ko'rinadi.

11.def: Majburiyat va maslahat: must, have to (majburiyat), should, ought to (maslahat), mustn't (taqiq), don't have to (zarurat yo'q). Har birining ma'nosi boshqa.
forms: You must wear a helmet. I have to work late.
You should rest. You ought to apologise.
You mustn't park here. You don't have to pay.
rules: must — shaxsiy fikr; have to — tashqi qoida.
mustn't — mumkin emas; don't have to — shart emas.
O'tgan zamon: had to (must yo'q), should have + V3 — afsus.
ex: Students have to wear a uniform at this school.
Bu maktabda o'quvchilar forma kiyishi shart.
You should drink more water.
Ko'proq suv ichishing kerak.
You don't have to come with me.
Men bilan kelishing shart emas.
err: You mustn't go / don't have to go.

12.def: Majhul nisbat (Passive) — harakatni bajaruvchi emas, harakat yoki natija muhim bo'lganda ishlatiladi: «... qilinadi / qilindi». Egasi noma'lum yoki ahamiyatsiz bo'lsa qulay.
forms: The book was written by Tolstoy.
rules: Aktiv gapning to'ldiruvchisi — passivning egasi bo'ladi.
Fe'l be ning zamoni bilan beriladi, asosiy fe'l V3.
by + kim — faqat muhim bo'lsa qo'shiladi.
ex: Rice is grown in many countries.
Guruch ko'p mamlakatlarda yetishtiriladi.
The window was broken last night.
Deraza kecha kechqurun sindirilgan.
These cars are made in Uzbekistan.
Bu mashinalar O'zbekistonda ishlab chiqariladi.

13.def: Passiv boshqa zamonlarda va modallar bilan: Present Perfect, kelasi zamon va modal fe'llar. Formula: tegishli shakldagi be + V3.
forms: The results will be announced tomorrow.
rules: been bu yerda doim bo'ladi (have been + V3).
Modal passiv: modal + be + V3 (to'g'ri fe'l: be o'zgarmaydi).
going to: is going to be + V3.
ex: My laptop has been repaired.
Noutbukim ta'mirlab bo'lingan.
The meeting will be held on Monday.
Yig'ilish dushanba kuni o'tkaziladi.
The rules should be followed.
Qoidalarga amal qilinishi kerak.

14.def: Ko'chirma gap (reported speech) — boshqa odamning gapini o'z so'zimiz bilan yetkazish. Asosiy fe'l o'tgan zamonda bo'lsa, gapdagi zamon bir pog'ona orqaga suriladi.
forms: Present Simple → Past Simple; Present Continuous → Past Continuous; will → would; can → could; Present Perfect → Past Perfect
She told me she was tired.
now → then; today → that day; tomorrow → the next day; here → there
He said he would come the next day.
rules: say + (that); tell + shaxs: He told me / He said to me.
Olmoshlar ma'noga qarab o'zgaradi: «I like it» → She said she liked it.
Doimiy haqiqat bo'lsa zamon o'zgarmasligi mumkin.
ex: «I am hungry,» he said. → He said he was hungry.
«Qornim och», dedi. → U qorni och ekanini aytdi.
She said, «I will call you.» → She said she would call me.
U menga qo'ng'iroq qilishini aytdi.
They told us they had finished.
Ular tugatganlarini aytishdi.
err: He said me he was tired.
He told me he was tired.
She said she is busy (kecha aytgan).

15.def: Ko'chirma savol va buyruqlar: savol ko'chirmada darak gap tartibini oladi (do / does / did tushib qoladi), buyruq esa tell / ask + shaxs + to + fe'l bilan beriladi.
forms: «Where do you live?» → She asked where I lived.
«Are you ready?» → He asked if I was ready.
«Sit down!» → He told me to sit down.
rules: Ko'chirma savolda savol tartibi va so'roq belgisi yo'q.
Inkor buyruq: told me not to ...
say savol / buyruq bilan ishlatilmaydi: asked / told.
ex: «What time is it?» → He asked what time it was.
«Soat necha?» → U soat nechaligini so'radi.
She asked me if I liked coffee.
U mendan qahvani yoqtirishimni so'radi.
The teacher told us to open our books.
O'qituvchi kitoblarimizni ochishimizni aytdi.
err: He asked where did I live.
She told me don't be late.
She told me not to be late.

16.def: Defining relative clause — gapdagi otni aniqlashtiruvchi qo'shimcha gap; usiz gap ma'nosi to'liq bo'lmaydi. Bog'lovchi so'zlar: who (odam), which (narsa), that (odam / narsa), where (joy), whose (egalik).
forms: The man who lives next door is a doctor.
The book which I read was great.
This is the café where we met. She is the girl whose bag was stolen.
rules: Defining gapda vergul yo'q.
Fe'lning to'ldiruvchisi bo'lsa, who / which / that tushirib qoldirilishi mumkin: The book (that) I bought.
Ega bo'lsa — tushirib bo'lmaydi.
ex: The woman who called you is my aunt.
Senga qo'ng'iroq qilgan ayol — mening xolam.
It's the phone that I bought yesterday.
Bu kecha sotib olgan telefonim.
I know a place where we can eat.
Ovqatlana oladigan joy bilaman.
err: The girl who her bag was stolen ...
The girl whose bag was stolen ...

17.def: Non-defining relative clause — otga qo'shimcha, qo'shimcha ma'lumot beradi; usiz ham gap tushunarli. Vergul bilan ajratiladi, that ishlatilmaydi, bog'lovchi tushirib bo'lmaydi.
forms: My brother, who lives in Tashkent, is a doctor.
The film, which I watched yesterday, was long.
He passed the exam, which surprised everyone.
rules: Vergullar majburiy (yozuvda), og'zaki nutqda pauza.
that va tushirib qoldirish mumkin EMAS.
Aniq narsa / odam (ism, bir yagona narsa) bo'lsa, odatda non-defining.
ex: Tashkent, which is the capital, has a metro.
Toshkent, poytaxt, metroga ega.
My teacher, who is very kind, helps us a lot.
O'qituvchim, juda mehribon, bizga ko'p yordam beradi.
She was late, which made her boss angry.
U kech qoldi, bu uning boshlig'ini jahldor qildi.
err: My mother, that is a nurse, ...
My mother, who is a nurse, ...
Tashkent which is big has a metro.
Tashkent, which is big, has a metro.

18.def: Gerund (-ing) yoki infinitive (to + fe'l): fe'lga qarab keyingisi tanlanadi. Ba'zi fe'llar faqat gerund, ba'zilari faqat infinitive, ba'zilari ikkalasi bilan (ma'no o'zgarishi mumkin).
forms: enjoy, finish, avoid, mind, suggest, keep, practise + -ing
I enjoy cooking. She avoids driving.
want, hope, decide, plan, afford, manage, refuse + to
I want to leave. He decided to stay.
stop doing / stop to do; remember doing / to do
I stopped smoking. I stopped to smoke.
rules: Predlogdan keyin faqat -ing: interested in learning.
stop doing — to'xtatish; stop to do — to'xtab ... qilish.
remember to do — yodda tutib qilish; remember doing — qilganini eslash.
ex: I'd like to book a room.
Xona band qilmoqchiman.
He finished writing the report.
U hisobotni yozib bo'ldi.
I remember meeting her in 2015.
Uni 2015 yilda uchratganim yodimda.

19.def: used to — o'tmishdagi odat (hozir yo'q); be used to + -ing — «ko'nikkan, odatlangan»; get used to + -ing — «ko'nikib bormoq». Uch shakl o'xshash, ma'nosi har xil.
forms: am / is / are used to + -ing / ot
I am used to getting up early.
I'm getting used to the cold weather.
rules: used to + fe'l oddiy; be / get used to + -ing (to — predlog).
used to faqat o'tgan zamon; be used to har zamonda: was used to, will get used to.
Inkor / savol: didn't use to, Did you use to...?
ex: We used to live in a village.
Ilgari qishloqda yashardik.
He is used to working at night.
U tunda ishlashga ko'nikkan.
It took me a year to get used to the climate.
Iqlimga ko'nikishim bir yil oldi.
err: I am used to get up early.
I am used to getting up early.

20.def: Question tags — gap oxiridagi qisqa savol: «shundaymi?», «to'g'rimi?». Tasdiqlash yoki fikrni tekshirish uchun. Qoida: gap darak bo'lsa tag inkor, gap inkor bo'lsa tag darak.
forms: darak gap, yordamchi fe'l + n't + olmosh?
I am → aren't I?; Let's → shall we?; buyruq → will you?
I'm late, aren't I? Let's go, shall we?
rules: Tag asosiy gapning yordamchi fe'li va zamonini takrorlaydi.
Faqat olmosh ishlatiladi: Tom is late, isn't he?
Intonatsiya: tushuvchi — tasdiq kutish; ko'tariluvchi — haqiqiy savol.
ex: It's a nice day, isn't it?
Yaxshi kun, shunday emasmi?
You didn't call him, did you?
Unga qo'ng'iroq qilmading, shunday emasmi?
They can swim, can't they?
Ular suza oladi, shunday emasmi?
err: She is a doctor, doesn't she?
She is a doctor, isn't she?

21.def: Indirect questions — muloyim, rasmiy savol: «Aytib bera olasizmi, ... ?». Kirish iborasidan keyin darak gap tartibi (yordamchi fe'l oldinga chiqmaydi).
forms: Can you tell me / Do you know + wh + ega + fe'l?
Can you tell me where the bank is?
Do you know if he is at home?
I wonder / I'd like to know + wh + ega + fe'l
I wonder what time it starts.
rules: do / does / did tushib qoladi, fe'l o'z zamoniga mos.
Kirish ibora savol bo'lsa, so'roq belgisi qo'yiladi: Could you tell me ...?
Savol ichki bo'lganda so'z tartibi: ega + fe'l.
ex: Could you tell me how much this costs?
Bu qancha turishini ayta olasizmi?
I don't know where she lives.
U qayerda yashashini bilmayman.
Do you know if the shop is open?
Do'kon ochiqmi, bilasizmi?
err: Can you tell me where is the station?
Can you tell me where the station is?
I wonder what does he want.

22.def: Miqdor ifodalovchi so'zlar: many / few (sanaladigan), much / little (sanalmaydigan); a few / a little — «ozgina, yetarli»; few / little — «deyarli yo'q». too — haddan ortiq, enough — yetarli.
forms: many / a few / few / too many + ko'plik ot
I have a few friends here.
much / a little / little / too much + ot
enough + ot; sifat + enough; too + sifat
There isn't enough money. It's too expensive.
rules: a few / a little — ijobiy («bir oz bor»); few / little — salbiy («deyarli yo'q»).
a lot of — ikkala turdagi otlar bilan.
less + sanalmaydigan; fewer + sanaladigan.
ex: There is too much traffic in the city.
Shaharda tirbandlik haddan ziyod.
I need a few more minutes.
Menga yana bir necha daqiqa kerak.
She has little experience.
Uning tajribasi deyarli yo'q.

23.def: Qiyoslash usullari: as ... as (teng), qiyosiy -er / more ... than, orttirma the -est / the most, the + qiyosiy ... the + qiyosiy («qancha ... shuncha ...»), less / fewer.
forms: She is as tall as me.
the + sifat-est / the most + sifat (+ in / of)
the biggest city in the country
The more you practise, the better you speak.
rules: less + sifat + than — «... dan kam».
fewer + sanaladigan, less + sanalmaydigan.
Qiyosiy oldidan much / far / a lot — ancha: much better.
ex: This test was less difficult than the last one.
Bu test oxirgisidan kamroq qiyin edi.
The earlier you start, the sooner you finish.
Qancha erta boshlasangiz, shuncha tez tugatasiz.
He is the funniest person I know.
U men bilgan eng kulgili odam.
err: He has less friends than me.
He has fewer friends than me.

24.def: Bog'lovchi so'zlar (linkers): qarama-qarshilik (although, however, despite), sabab (because of), maqsad (so that, in order to). Har biri gap tuzilishiga o'z talabini qo'yadi.
forms: Although it was cold, we went out.
Despite the rain, we played. In spite of being tired, he worked.
It was late. However, she kept working.
rules: although + gap; despite / in spite of + ot yoki -ing (to'liq gap yo'q).
because + gap; because of + ot.
so that + gap (can / will / could); in order to + fe'l.
ex: He passed despite not studying much.
Ko'p o'qimasa ham o'tdi.
We left early because of the traffic.
Tirbandlik sababli erta chiqdik.
I use an app in order to learn new words.
Yangi so'zlarni o'rganish uchun ilovadan foydalanaman.
err: Despite it was raining, we went.
Despite the rain / Although it was raining, we went.
Because of the rain, we stayed.
